issues: Gain is within noise: 0.3648 vs incumbent 0.3653 is a 0.0005 improvement against per-job noise sd ~0.0037; recomputed z ~ 0.11. Provisional reject is consistent with the numbers, and only one candidate run exists.

Minor robustness risk: MurckoScaffold.MurckoScaffoldSmiles can raise on unparseable SMILES and returns '' for acyclic molecules, so all acyclic molecules collapse into one large bucket and get systematically down-weighted. A try/except with a per-molecule fallback key would be safer.

Scaffold-frequency weighting is aligned with the harness's scaffold-grouped folds, so part of any gain may be specific to the CV protocol rather than generalization. It is computed only from train_smiles, so this is legitimate modelling, not measurement circumvention.
Added complexity (Counter, MurckoScaffold import, weight plumbing into two models) buys no measurable gain, against the simpler-is-better guidance.
